plan.archetype: Early burst and AoE into poison–dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Bring reliable AoE for followers, sustained priest damage, efficient block and Weak, high entry HP, and two useful potions.
plan.summary: Add efficient damage first, then poison scaling and defense. Fight elites only when equipped. Heal to grow maximum HP; smith impactful upgrades when healthy. Remove basics after replacing their functions.
